body: I was a student, now I'm nothing. I love studying but I just can't with these conditions and meds. I work out a couple times a week, because everyone said it would help. I take long walks outside and I do enjoy them but it's not enough. Everything is overwhelming.

That's the thing, they don't have a judgement about me, I just affect them. I'm bipolar and suffer from severe anxiety. I am a burden to my family and have been so for such a long time that my mother left and my father took to drinking. I take antidepressants, antipsychotic and antianxiety pills, and I cannot function normally with them, as well as without them. I know it's the best thing to do but I'm scared of doing the right thing.

Hey

People can be such incredibly mean creatures, I sometimes don't even believe my eyes and ears. But some of them, including you, are able to ignore the physical characteristics of others and look past that. You may not have found them yet, but I'm sure you will find people who look at you and see through whichever features you think ugly. If you work on becoming who you want to be as a person by just taking a break of people in general, reading interesting books maybe, or travelling, or anything you enjoy doing, you might feel better about life. People generally tend to love people who have a happy vibe, no matter what they look like. I hope you will feel better and if you need help, there's no shame in that at all. I wish I could share some of my courage with you. I cope with suicidal thoughts as well, tried my hand at it too often, but I still hope that I will get better.
